archetypes.name: dyn-guidelines-cli
archetypes.rationale: New present-note CLI has status-dependent stdout contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/architectural_guidelines.py and its tests for exact stdout behavior across absent, invalid, pending-present, and clean-present cases. Confirm read_main remains byte-compatible and that no guideline deviation judgment moved into Python. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-design-guidelines-flow
archetypes.rationale: Design skill prose now delegates deterministic presentation to present-note at two gates.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed design skill references for Gate C and Step 1d.7. Confirm both paths use present-note, keep untrusted guideline caveats, and assess deviations against the correct artifact: design-outline.md for Step 1d.7 and plan.txt for Gate C. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
